column1: # SECURITY DEFINER functions taskiem_app may execute (spec 5.3).
# Each runs as taskiem_dispatch, past row-level security, so each is
# reviewed like security code. TestDefinersAllowList fails when the
# database and this list differ: a new definer granted to taskiem_app
# needs a line here, in its own change, with an owner who reviewed it and
# a one-line reason (what it returns, and why a tenant-scoped query cannot
# do it). The owner is the GitHub user who reviews changes to it, then
# the product area in brackets; .github/CODEOWNERS asks them to review
# any pull request that changes this file.
